info.name: JSONPlaceholder QA Portfolio
info.description: Portfolio API checks against a public mock API. Write operations are simulated.

exec: pm.test('First post contains expected fields', () => { const p = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('userId', 'id', 'title', 'body'); });
pm.test('Post id is 1 and userId is numeric', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.id).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.userId).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Title and body are non-empty strings', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.title).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(p.body).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Unknown post follows documented mock API behavior', () => { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('{}'); });

pm.test('Response contains submitted fields', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.title).to.eql('QA portfolio API test'); pm.expect(p.userId).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('id'); });
